title: theHarvester results
description: Every finding is one row with a recordType (host, email, ip, url, asn, shodan, person, or any other theHarvester result under its own name), plus one summary row at the end. theHarvester's own reports and console output are saved unchanged as files.

results.title: All results (results)
results.description: Every row the run found. Use the Subdomains, Emails and Run summary views, or filter by recordType.

files.title: Report files (files)
files.description: theHarvester's own output saved as-is: full console output (theharvester-output.txt, which includes API-scan results), its JSON and XML reports, and page screenshots when turned on.
